class Gauge {
  private measured = 'low';
  get value() { return this.measured; }
  private set value(level: string) { this.measured = level; }
  update(level: string) { this.value = level; }
}
class RecordValue {
  get value(): number { return 2; }
  set value(_value: string) { return; }
}
class Initialized {
  value;
  constructor() {
    do { this.value = 4; } while (false);
  }
}
const gauge = new Gauge();
gauge.update('high');
console.log(gauge.value, new RecordValue().value, new Initialized().value);
function printOptions(options: { color?: string }, value: number | undefined, backup: number) {
  console.log({ color: 'red', ...options }.color, (value ?? backup) || 3, (value || backup) ?? 2);
}
printOptions({}, undefined, 1);
